targets.rawSql:
select
  s.db_unique_name,
  s.dbid,
  s.database_product,
  s.database_edition,
  s.database_version_full,
  s.database_role,
  s.protection_mode,
  s.protection_level,
  s.platform_name
from oracle_database_status_samples s
join oracle_latest_scrape_status st
  on st.source_database = s.source_database
 and st.collector = 'operational.database_status'
 and st.collected_at = s.collected_at
where s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by s.inst_id
limit 1;

panels.title: Database Identity and Protection
panels.description: Stable database identity, Oracle product version, role, and currently observed Data Guard protection state.

targets.rawSql:
select
  s.inst_id,
  s.instance_name,
  s.instance_status,
  s.database_status,
  s.open_mode,
  s.con_name,
  s.startup_time
from oracle_database_status_samples s
join oracle_latest_scrape_status st
  on st.source_database = s.source_database
 and st.collector = 'operational.database_status'
 and st.collected_at = s.collected_at
where s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by s.inst_id;

panels.title: Instance Status
panels.description: Current status of each visible Oracle instance. Missing RAC instances remain an availability signal.

targets.rawSql:
select
  s.inst_id,
  s.cpu_count,
  s.sga_allocated_bytes,
  s.sga_max_bytes,
  s.pga_allocated_bytes,
  s.pga_max_allocated_bytes,
  s.pga_aggregate_limit,
  case when s.pga_aggregate_limit > 0
    then s.pga_allocated_bytes * 100.0 / s.pga_aggregate_limit
  end as pga_current_percent,
  case when s.pga_aggregate_limit > 0
    then s.pga_max_allocated_bytes * 100.0 / s.pga_aggregate_limit
  end as pga_peak_percent
from oracle_instance_samples s
join oracle_latest_scrape_status st
  on st.source_database = s.source_database
 and st.collector = 'operational.instance'
 and st.collected_at = s.collected_at
where s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by s.inst_id;

panels.title: Instance Memory Allocation
panels.description: Observed Oracle memory allocation compared with configured capacity. PGA maximum is the high-water value since instance startup.

targets.rawSql:
select
  tablespace_name,
  contents,
  round((used_bytes * 100.0 / nullif(allocated_bytes, 0))::numeric, 2) as allocated_used_percent,
  round(used_percent::numeric, 2) as maximum_used_percent,
  used_bytes,
  case when allocated_bytes is not null then greatest(allocated_bytes - used_bytes, 0) end as allocated_free_bytes,
  allocated_bytes,
  case when allocated_bytes is not null then greatest(max_bytes - allocated_bytes, 0) end as autoextend_headroom_bytes,
  max_bytes
from oracle_latest_tablespace_samples
where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by maximum_used_percent desc, allocated_used_percent desc;

panels.title: Tablespace Capacity
panels.description: Used space is compared with both current file allocation and maximum autoextend capacity. Allocation pressure is a watch signal; maximum pressure is the capacity risk.

targets.rawSql:
with demand as (
  select
    collected_at,
    case stat_name when 'DB CPU' then 'DB CPU cores' else 'DB time demand' end as metric,
    sum(value_per_second) / 1000000.0 as value
  from oracle_system_counter_rates
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and con_id = 0
    and stat_name in ('DB CPU', 'DB time')
    and value_per_second is not null
  group by collected_at, stat_name
), capacity as (
  select collected_at, 'Configured CPU capacity' as metric, sum(cpu_count)::double precision as value
  from oracle_instance_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and cpu_count is not null
  group by collected_at
)
select collected_at as "time", metric, value from demand
union all
select collected_at as "time", metric, value from capacity
order by 1, 2;

panels.title: Oracle CPU and Database Time Demand
panels.description: DB CPU as consumed CPU cores and DB time as average foreground database demand. Configured CPU capacity is shown as a reference, aggregated across visible RAC instances.

targets.rawSql:
select
  collected_at as "time",
  wait_class || ' - inst ' || inst_id as metric,
  wait_micro_per_second / 1000000.0 as value
from oracle_wait_class_rates
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and wait_micro_per_second is not null
order by 1;

select
  collected_at as "time",
  case stat_name
    when 'parse count (total)' then 'Parses'
    when 'execute count' then 'Executions'
    when 'user commits' then 'Commits'
    when 'user rollbacks' then 'Rollbacks'
  end as metric,
  sum(value_per_second)::double precision as value
from oracle_system_counter_rates
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and con_id = 0
  and stat_name in ('parse count (total)', 'execute count', 'user commits', 'user rollbacks')
  and value_per_second is not null
group by collected_at, stat_name
order by 1, 2;

panels.title: SQL and Transaction Rates
panels.description: Database-wide foreground SQL calls and transaction outcomes. CDB totals are used and RAC instances are aggregated.

targets.rawSql:
select
  collected_at as "time",
  case stat_name
    when 'session logical reads' then 'Logical reads'
    when 'physical reads' then 'Physical reads'
    when 'physical writes' then 'Physical writes'
  end as metric,
  sum(value_per_second)::double precision as value
from oracle_system_counter_rates
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and con_id = 0
  and stat_name in ('session logical reads', 'physical reads', 'physical writes')
  and value_per_second is not null
group by collected_at, stat_name
order by 1, 2;

panels.title: Database Block Activity
panels.description: Logical and physical Oracle database block rates, aggregated across RAC instances at CDB level.

targets.rawSql:
select
  collected_at as "time",
  case stat_name
    when 'physical read total IO requests' then 'Read IOPS'
    else 'Write IOPS'
  end as metric,
  sum(value_per_second)::double precision as value
from oracle_system_counter_rates
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and con_id = 0
  and stat_name in ('physical read total IO requests', 'physical write total IO requests')
  and value_per_second is not null
group by collected_at, stat_name
order by 1, 2;

panels.title: Physical IOPS
panels.description: Oracle-visible physical read and write I/O requests per second, aggregated across RAC instances.

targets.rawSql:
select
  collected_at as "time",
  case stat_name
    when 'physical read total bytes' then 'Read throughput'
    else 'Write throughput'
  end as metric,
  sum(value_per_second)::double precision as value
from oracle_system_counter_rates
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and con_id = 0
  and stat_name in ('physical read total bytes', 'physical write total bytes')
  and value_per_second is not null
group by collected_at, stat_name
order by 1, 2;

panels.title: Physical I/O Throughput
panels.description: Oracle-visible physical read and write throughput, aggregated across RAC instances.

targets.rawSql:
select
  collected_at as "time",
  'Redo generation' as metric,
  sum(value_per_second)::double precision as value
from oracle_system_counter_rates
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and con_id = 0
  and stat_name = 'redo size'
  and value_per_second is not null
group by collected_at
order by 1;

panels.title: Redo Generation
panels.description: Database-wide redo generation rate at CDB level, aggregated across RAC instances.

targets.rawSql:
select
  collected_at as "time",
  metric_name || ' - inst ' || inst_id || ' con ' || con_id as metric,
  value
from oracle_system_metric_samples
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by 1;

select
  inst_id,
  resource_name,
  current_value,
  limit_value,
  round(used_percent::numeric, 2) as used_percent
from oracle_latest_resource_limit_samples
where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and not limit_unlimited
  and limit_value > 0
order by used_percent desc;

select
  inst_id,
  diskgroup_name,
  round(used_percent::numeric, 2) as used_percent,
  pg_size_pretty(total_bytes) as total,
  pg_size_pretty(free_bytes) as free,
  pg_size_pretty(usable_bytes) as usable
from oracle_latest_asm_diskgroup_samples
where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by used_percent desc;

select
  collector,
  success,
  collected_at as last_collection,
  round(duration_seconds::numeric, 3) as duration_seconds,
  sample_count,
  error_message
from oracle_latest_scrape_status
where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
order by success, collector;

panels.description: Maximum observed collector duration per display bucket for the selected Oracle database. Rising duration without query failures is an early pressure signal.

targets.rawSql:
select
  date_bin(greatest('${__interval}'::interval, interval '10 seconds'), collected_at, '1970-01-01'::timestamptz) as "time",
  collector as metric,
  max(duration_seconds)::double precision as value
from oracle_scrape_status
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
group by 1, 2
order by 1, 2;

panels.title: Oracle Collector Duration

panels.description: Activity-query duration as a percentage of its configured timeout. Sustained growth toward 100% precedes timeout failures and missing DAH samples.

targets.rawSql:
with runtime as (
  select configured_query_timeout_seconds
  from harry_latest_runtime_status
  where scheduler = 'activity'
  order by observed_at desc
  limit 1
)
select
  date_bin(greatest('${__interval}'::interval, interval '10 seconds'), s.collected_at, '1970-01-01'::timestamptz) as "time",
  'Activity timeout used' as metric,
  max(s.duration_seconds * 100.0 / nullif(runtime.configured_query_timeout_seconds, 0))::double precision as value
from oracle_scrape_status s
cross join runtime
where $__timeFilter(s.collected_at)
  and s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and s.collector = 'activity'
group by 1
order by 1;
